children: Ashland entered into a Deed of Amendment and Restatement to extend and update its European accounts receivable securitization program. The facility remains a revolving €125 million program and now runs through September 21, 2029. Bank of America Europe became the committed purchaser, while Bank of America continues as administrative and structuring agent. The amendments align terms with current market standards and support Ashland's ongoing liquidity needs.
: Amended and restated European accounts receivable securitization facility (revolving, €125 million)
: Bank of America Europe and Bank of America
: Extend EU receivables securitization and maintain liquidity
